description: Get a short message in your thread when a GitHub pull request or Linear issue you follow changes. Subscribe from the agent or the bb subscriptions command, in bulk, and a count in the thread heading shows how many items you follow. Changes to a busy thread are coalesced into one message and rewritten in place, so a fast-moving issue never floods the queue. GitHub uses the gh CLI already authenticated on the bb server, and Linear needs one read-only personal API key.
